name: qa_usbdisk_rw
title: OS-USBDISK U1d, Linux only, the WRITABLE step: copy both ways with a checksum (SIZE_MB, default 16; the release pass is 100), remount, eject

steps.say: OS-USBDISK U1d, rows QA-GLB-015..017, 019..021. Linux only (Windows and macOS: untested, not run). THE UNIT MUST ALREADY BE IN THE BOOT DISK MODE: power it off, hold Shift + F1 + F7 while powering on until the strip 'USB DISK - EJECT ON THE COMPUTER OR PRESS A KEY' shows, then start this run (--expect-volume XXXX-XXXX is optional); the PC side touches nothing else. NO KEY IS PRESSED until the last step (a key restarts the unit; while the computer has the disk writable and mounted it takes two presses)
USBDISK-BOOT (QA-GLB-015): no mount, no project, no outputs, the card is the computer's

expect: boot: chord Shift\+F1\+F7, USB DISK mode
steps.note: the log: the chord was read, the DISK set is on the bus, the card was opened for the computer, writable (the writable step); no mount, no project load, no output opened
the card is the computer's: nothing is mounted by FatFs
the strip (soft: the notice is re-posted every second and may have just expired)
(soft: the screen is the app's own with the persistent strip)

steps.say: USBDISK-ENUM (QA-GLB-019): the computer lists the unit's disk, writable (ro=0)

steps.note: the write-protect bit is clear: the boot disk is exported writable (since 2026-10-17)

steps.say: USBDISK-COPY (QA-GLB-020): both ways with a checksum. The write goes only into o3-usbdisk-test/ on the card

steps.note: writes a deterministic file, fsync, unmounts and mounts again (the computer's cache is gone), reads it back off the card, compares sha256, deletes it
and the card's own files off to the computer with two-read agreement

steps.say: QA-GLB-023 is a separate BY-HAND check, not a step of this run (the runner cannot press the unit's keys): in a boot disk session with the disk mounted and NOT ejected, ONE key on the unit must not restart it: the strip warns 'THE COMPUTER MAY STILL BE WRITING: KEY AGAIN' (and the run above still passes); 6 s later the usual strip is back; a second key inside 5 s restarts. After the eject below one key restarts at once
USBDISK-EJECT (QA-GLB-017): the computer ejects the medium (udisksctl power-off), the unit says so

steps.note: the computer's next command gets NOT READY / MEDIUM NOT PRESENT: the block device is gone or reads 0 blocks
the strip: DISK EJECTED - PRESS ANY KEY TO RESTART (read at once: udisksctl power-off then removes the device on the computer's side, and the console goes with it)

steps.say: udisksctl power-off also turns the computer's port off: the unit leaves the bus (kernel 'USB disconnect'), so nothing more is read here. A person presses any key on the unit: it restarts into the normal boot with the card mounted; run boot_version next
